document.abstract: A discussion of the various problems encountered in the road-showing of “Fantasia” with the multiple-track Fantasound equipment. The experiences and conditions encountered are presented as a guide for the further development of this very important field. It is expected that this system will add greatly to the dramatic presentation of pictures and will, in some form, replace our sound-reproduction systems.
